info.title: ZME Resource API
info.description: Resource-oriented media discovery, ephemeral release search, and download API. Local roles and resource ownership further restrict every operation.

tags.name: media-catalog
tags.description: Search the configured media metadata catalog.

tags.name: release-acquisition
tags.description: Search releases and submit selected candidates to downloaders.

tags.name: library
tags.description: Operate the signed-in user library and music collections.

tags.name: configuration
tags.description: Administrator-only indexer, source, and downloader configuration.

tags.name: downloads
tags.description: Create, inspect, and manage owned downloads.
